All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
BBItem
Finite, single-content container shared by the Big and Huge Bucket tiers.
BucketDefinitions
Defines the registry identities and capacities of the mod's bucket items.
BucketLootTables
Maps each bucket inject loot table to the vanilla structure loot tables it is added to on both loaders.
BucketLootTables.Reward
One independent structure-loot roll; the shipped manifest supplies its target-table set.
BucketOperations
Loader-specific primitives used by the shared FluidTransactions and HeldTransfers orchestration and by shared bucket items directly.
BucketOperations.BlockFluidStore
A loader-native fluid store exposed by one block face, in millibuckets.
BucketOperations.HeldMove
One held-container fluid move: the fluid moved and both containers as they stand afterward.
BucketOperations.Holder
Holds the loader-installed implementation without forcing eager platform initialization.
BucketOperations.MobBucketContents
The entity type and fluid a vanilla-style MobBucketItem carries.
BucketState
The sole reader and writer of every bucket family's persistent state, kept in the stack's NBT.
BucketState.Mode
Identifies which mutually exclusive payload family a bucket's root NBT contains.
Cauldrons
Vanilla water, lava, and powder-snow cauldron transitions for Big, Huge, and Source Buckets: block-state changes, protection, sound, and cauldron-stat accounting.
Cauldrons.CauldronFluid
A fluid that a vanilla cauldron holds as one bucket-volume.
ClientPlatform
The client's loader seam: the loader's fluid rendering facts and spawn-egg lookup, plus the config directory and loader name the diagnostic reports need.
ClientPlatform.FluidFacts
Loader-resolved rendering facts for a stored fluid.
ClientPlatform.FluidFactsSource
Resolves a stored fluid's rendering facts through the loader's client fluid API.
CreativeBucketCatalog
Defines the ordered contents of the Some Buckets creative tab.
DiagnosticReport
Shared formatting, classification vocabulary, and file output for the /sb diagnostic commands.
DiagnosticReport.Row
One report entry.
DiagnosticReport.Status
Classification of one report entry, most benign first.
Dispensers
Dispenser behavior for all six Some Buckets items.
EggDiagnostics
/sb eggs: walks every registered entity type and records the colors the Mob Bucket tints its overlays with, flagging capturable types that have no spawn egg and eggs whose two colors give no usable tint.
FluidBucketItem
Base of the mod's single-fluid-container buckets (Big, Huge, and Source Bucket): the fluid container rules every loader's fluid storage and the shared fluid logic apply, content naming, the crafting remainder contract, lava fuel, cow milking, milk drinking, the item-model state protocol, and the gesture helpers both item classes share.
FluidDiagnostics
/sb fluids: walks every registered source fluid and mirrors the Big and Source Bucket bar-color path so a modpack's fluids can be checked for ones that render as the fallback color or collapse to near-black.
FluidDiagnostics.FluidColorSample
One fluid's client color breakdown.
FluidTransactions
Loader-neutral fluid transactions for Big, Huge, and Source Buckets after an item or dispenser selects a gesture, plus vanilla-contract world pickup and fixed-water placement.
FluidTransactions.SourceTarget
Read-only classification of the exact block targeted by an assigned Source Bucket.
HeldTransfers
Held-hand bucket operations: transfer between one of this mod's fluid buckets and whatever the other hand holds, milk handling, and settling the hand afterward.
HeldTransfers.HeldInteraction
Result of an entity interaction performed with a temporary hand stack.
ItemEntityAccessor
Reads the player an item entity was dropped for, which vanilla pickup alone may collect.
JBItem
FIFO storage for item-stack entries and the shared interaction base for Junk and Trash Buckets.
MBItem
FIFO storage for full mob snapshots, limited to one exact entity type per bucket.
ModSoundIds
Registry ids for the mod's custom sound events, shared by both loaders' registration and common item code.
ProtectionContext
Identity attached to an authorized mutation.
Protections
The permission checks applied before a bucket changes the world, expressed as the vanilla gates and loader events a player doing the same thing by hand would pass.
SBItem
Infinite source and sink assigned to one server-allowed fluid or to allowed milk.
SBPolicy
Immutable, reloadable view of the server allowlist governing every Source Bucket input and output boundary, including the special non-fluid milk mode.
SomeBucketItem
Base of every Some Buckets item.
SomeBuckets
Shared mod identity and setup used by both loader entrypoints and by common code.
StoredFluid
Immutable loader-neutral fluid identity, amount in millibuckets, and optional variant payload.
TBItem
One-entry storage bucket whose intake merges only when the complete incoming stack fits.
